questions.text: Priya advanced a loan of Rs. 2,40,000 to the firm 9 months before the year end. The partnership deed is silent on loan interest. Interest on Priya's loan for the year is:
questions.explanation: no deed -> 6% p.a. for 9 months = Rs. 10,800  Correct option A. Distractors: B = used 10% instead of the statutory 6%; C = used 12% instead of the statutory 6%; D = charged a full year's interest.
